# Animated sprite: shipped model and direct occupant census

Status: **measured data facts**, 2026-10-23, re-animsprite-as5b. Companion to
[animated-sprite.md](animated-sprite.md), §7.1. This is an identifier inventory,
not game resources or an assertion that each entry is instantiated at runtime.

All 1,084 models below have type `29A5D1EC` and reside in `SimCity_1.dat`.
The model group and instance form the remaining two components of their TGI.
A reference cell lists `exemplar-group:instance/property-ID`; all listed records
have exemplar type `6534284A`. An em dash means no literal consecutive TGI triple
was found in any numeric property of the 9,345 parsed shipped exemplars/cohorts.
No inheritance, family expansion, state-derived key arithmetic, effect scripts,
plugin packages or runtime reachability is inferred from an empty cell.
Multiple references in one cell are separate property occurrences.

Scope: EP1.dat, Intro.dat, SimCity_1.dat through SimCity_5.dat, Sound.dat from the
installed GOG Deluxe directory. See §7.1 of the main spec for package identity,
counts, limits and selected named examples. Enumerated using the read-only
`tools/dbpf.py` DBPF/QFS and binary exemplar readers. All eight packages parsed;
there were no exemplar decode errors. Sort order is unsigned (group, instance).
